class.name: OcgGraphic3dTexture2d
class.brief_description: This abstract class for managing 2D textures
class.description: ! This abstract class for managing 2D textures

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a texture from a predefined texture name set. MipMaps levels will be automatically generated if needed.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a texture from the pixmap. MipMaps levels will be automatically generated if needed.

method.name: Name
method.description: Returns the name of the predefined textures or NOT_2D_UNKNOWN when the name is given as a filename.

method.name: SetImage
method.description: Assign new image to the texture. Note that this method does not invalidate already uploaded resources - consider calling ::UpdateRevision() if needed.

method.name: NumberOfTextures
method.description: Returns the number of predefined textures.
